newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israel shells hit Lebanon's Sidon port.
newsitem.headline: Israel shells hit Lebanon's Sidon port.

text.p: Three Israeli shells hit Lebanon's southern port city of Sidon on Monday, security sources said.
There were no immediate reports of casualties in the attack.
It was the first time that Sidon, 40 km (25 miles) south of the capital Beirut, had been targeted by Israeli shells since the Jewish state launched a major offensive in south Lebanon in April 1996.
The shelling came hours after a roadside bomb killed two Lebanese civilian teenagers and seriously wounded a third just north of Lebanon's south Lebanon occupation zone.

Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas are fighting to drive Israeli forces and their local militia allied from the 15 km (nine-mile) wide zone, site of frquent clashes, roadside bombs and rocket attacks.
